findings.evidence: grep `signSum_empty|signCount_empty` in code/TauCeti: no matches. Roots.lean:40-41 proves the zero case only via `simp [tarskiQuery_eq_signSum, signSum_eq_sum]`; Roots.lean:66-71 handles `signCount` at roots only under `hp : p ≠ 0`. roadmap README.md:316-317 requires zero polynomials be covered.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem signSum_empty (p) : signSum ∅ p = 0` and `@[simp] theorem signCount_empty (Q σ) : signCount ∅ Q σ = 0`; prove `tarskiQuery_zero_left` by `simp [tarskiQuery_eq_signSum]`, and add the matching `signCount_roots_zero : signCount (0 : R[X]).roots.toFinset Q σ = 0` next to `signCount_roots_pos`.
findings.issue: No empty-set base cases: `signSum ∅ p = 0` and `signCount ∅ Q σ = 0` are missing, so the zero-polynomial case for `signCount` (roadmap-required) needs `signCount_eq_card_filter`, `roots_zero`, `toFinset_zero`, `filter_empty`, `card_empty` by hand, and `tarskiQuery_zero_left` (Roots.lean:41) has to unfold via `signSum_eq_sum` to get through.

findings.evidence: Polynomial.lean:102 `∃ x ∈ Z, ∀ j, …` vs Polynomial.lean:159 `∃ x : Z, ∀ j, …` and Polynomial.lean:124 `∀ x : Z, ∃ c, …`; Polynomial.lean:51-52 `signSum_eq_sum` is `∑ x : Z`. roadmap Suggested.lean:52-53 defines `tarskiQuery p q := ∑ x ∈ p.roots.toFinset, (SignType.sign (q.eval x) : ℤ)`.
findings.fix: State `fullInverse_mulVec_signSum_pos` with `∃ x ∈ Z, ∀ j, sign ((Q j).eval x) = σ j` (the proof already produces this via `Subtype.exists, exists_prop`), take `cover : ∀ x ∈ Z, ∃ c, columns c = fun j => sign ((Q j).eval x)` in `mulVec_signCount`, and add `signSum_eq_sum_finset : signSum Z p = ∑ x ∈ Z, (sign (p.eval x) : ℤ)` (hence `tarskiQuery p q = ∑ x ∈ p.roots.toFinset, …`, the roadmap's definition form).
findings.issue: Subtype indexing leaks into public statements: `fullInverse_mulVec_signSum_pos` concludes `∃ x : Z, ∀ j, …`, `mulVec_signCount` takes `cover : ∀ x : Z, ∃ c, …`, and `signSum_eq_sum` is the only sum restatement and is in `∑ x : Z` form, while the sibling API (`signCount_pos`, `signCount_eq_card_filter`, `signSum_eq_card_sub_card`, and the roadmap's `tarskiQuery`) uses the ambient `x ∈ Z` form. Consumers must convert with `Subtype.exists`/`Subtype.forall`/`Finset.sum_coe_sort`.

summary: Both prior findings are met (signCount_eq_card_filter, and the zero/one query lemmas for signSum and tarskiQuery). Two gaps remain: the empty-set base cases for signSum/signCount are absent (the file itself unfolds to the sum to prove tarskiQuery_zero_left), and subtype-indexed forms (∃ x : Z / ∀ x : Z) leak into three public statements while the sibling API uses the ambient ∃ x ∈ Z form.
